description: This file defines types, functions, and constants related to managing secret plans, including validation, resolution, and normalization of secret plan data in a TypeScript project.

methods.name: resolveValidatedPlanTarget
methods.description: Validates and resolves a candidate secret plan target against known target types and registry.

methods.name: isSecretsApplyPlan
methods.description: Checks if a given object conforms to the SecretsApplyPlan structure.

methods.name: normalizeSecretsPlanOptions
methods.description: Provides default values for optional plan options.
